## compare

The `compare()` function orchestrates `compare_dependencies()` and other helpers to summarise changes between package versions.
```{r}
pkg_diff <- compare("dplyr", "1.1.4", "1.0.9")
```

## Functions

```{r}
pkg_diff$functions_diff$added
```
```{r}
pkg_diff$functions_diff$removed
```

```{r}
pkg_diff
```


## dependencies

```{r}
pkg_diff$dependencies_diff$dependencies
```
